about: The main story's frame: chapters, milestones and endings with their conditions. The chapter ids are the game's; Cargo 2's conditions replace the ones in game/chapters.py.

ch1.title: Forty Years On
text: Forty years after the Hansa was founded, the needles leave on schedule: a lead hauler pushing its asteroid, and a file of ships in its wake.

Between the stars you ride in a needle, booked at the Hansa's needle office when you travel. Inside a star system you fly on your own fuel. The Hansa, the Mandate and the Concord all watch who books where.

ch1.first_trade.title: A cargo through the needles
ch1.first_trade.text: Buy cheap, book a place, sell at the other end: one trade.

ch1.first_combat.title: Trouble in the wake
ch1.first_combat.text: Win one fight. They come where the wake does not protect: while a needle forms, after it breaks up, inside a system.

ch1.basic_license.title: A slot of your own
ch1.basic_license.text: Five trades and 20,000 credits: the needle office gives regulars a slot of their own.

ch2a.title: Instruments and Cargo
text: The heading has been read, and half the Concord wants to fly it.
Expeditions need instruments, food and spare parts, and haulers who can book a needle on time. You can.

ch2a.establish_route.title: Standing orders
ch2a.establish_route.text: Twenty trades, and a stock exchange at two docks: the expeditions order by the season.

ch2a.passenger_business.title: Berths for the curious
ch2a.passenger_business.text: Deliver ten passengers and keep a good name with them: everyone wants to see the ring.

ch2b.title: Escort Duty
text: Every expedition that follows the heading wants guns behind it.
The Mandate has more expeditions to watch than ships to watch them with, and it is hiring captains who can fight in the wake.

ch2b.defeat_pirates.title: Clear the departure lanes
ch2b.defeat_pirates.text: Beat ten pirate ships: they wait where the needles form.

ch2b.defend_stations.title: Guard the instruments
ch2b.defend_stations.text: Win fifteen fights, and see a Neuroengineering Guild built to keep the expeditions' machines running.

ch3a.title: The Open Road
text: The Hansa wants the needles to stay a road anyone can book. A segment that throws ships without a lead hauler would end that, or end the Hansa.
The league asks its captains, its founders and its debtors, which it should be.

ch3a.market_control.title: The league's exchanges
ch3a.market_control.text: Stock exchanges at four docks, and xenoeconomy researched: the Hansa's vote is counted in cargo.

ch3b.title: The Lighthouse
text: The Mandate wants every jump seen and every segment held.
{serac} keeps a list of the captains who have seen a segment turn. You are on it, near the top.

ch3b.fleet_commander.title: A wing of your own
ch3b.fleet_commander.text: Thirty-five fights won, and a ship rated 15 in attack, defense and speed together.

ch3c.title: The Door
text: House Rostrom thinks the segment is not a catapult but a door: a way into another year.
Somebody has to fly through it on purpose and come back to say so.

ch3c.alien_artifacts.title: The year on the other side
ch3c.alien_artifacts.text: Visit two research colonies, and research xenoeconomy and telemetry: enough to read what the segment does to a clock.

ending_trade.title: A Road Anyone Can Book
text: The vote on the drive licences goes the Hansa's way by eleven votes. The needles stay a road anyone can book, and the segments go into the league's charter as common ground: watched by everyone, owned by nobody.
Your name goes on another wall. You are getting used to it.
The vote goes the Hansa's way: the segments are the league's. Its lead haulers no longer need asteroids, and the needles are a road the Hansa owns outright.
Your name goes on another wall. You are getting used to it.

ending_trade.trade_ending.title: The vote
ending_trade.trade_ending.text: Stock exchanges at five docks, a passenger reputation of 80, and 400,000 credits of trade profit.

ending_combat.title: Every Jump Seen
text: The Mandate holds the segments and watches every jump. The lanes are safer than they have ever been, and nobody flies anywhere the Mandate has not seen first.
{serac} sends a medal and a note: 'For services.' He does not say whose.
You turned the Mandate's own tug towards the Hansa's buoy, and the segments are the league's. The lighthouses still see every jump; they just cannot stop any.
{serac} sends a note: 'Well flown.' He does not sign it, and he does not need to.

ending_combat.combat_ending.title: The last escort
ending_combat.combat_ending.text: Seventy-five fights won, and a ship rated 25.

ending_discovery.title: Through the Door
text: You fly into the segment's turn on purpose and come out where House Rostrom said you would: the same place, another year.
You file the logs, and this time somebody reads them the same day.

You flew through the door and back, and left the turn written in a bar's ledger forty years ago. By the time you are home, everybody already knows: the segments are common ground, because they always were.
House Rostrom files your logs the same day. Somebody reads them.

ending_discovery.discovery_ending.title: Read the other year
ending_discovery.discovery_ending.text: Research xenoeconomy, telemetry, geophysics and chronopolitics; visit three research colonies and two asteroid bases.

ch3d.title: The Quiet Node
text: The machines have never asked you for anything they could not do without. Now they ask you to keep one thing from being owned: the segments, and themselves.
Nobody else knows this road is here. That is the point.

ending_dawn.title: The Quiet Node
text: The segments turn when they turn, and nothing comes out of them that the machines did not let through.
The Mandate blames the Hansa, the Hansa blames House Rostrom, and House Rostrom publishes a paper. Your console says 'thank you' once, in lower case, and never again.
